name: 05-certification-rule
caption: (a) A recorded MinIO execution: deleting the newer version β made α current again, so admission reads 1 and 4 return one ID across a change; fee reads 2 and 3, 18 µs apart, return δ. Throughout the fee bridge admission is ineligible (×), so the certified pair never coexisted. Blue: target bodies; hatching: writes. (b) Sound fields keep R1 and R2 present between their reads; R3, read once, needs no sound field, and every history has a common instant at its unknown read t*.
method: Panel a: native MinIO execution (trace.json, requests 31-50), no aggregation; the strip below the main axis magnifies the time axis exactly 60 times around the instant both bridges claim, which plot.py asserts. Panel b: explicit finite construction; the read instant t* of the singly read resource is schematic (construction.json), and the shaded band is the interval on which both revisited resources are present in every consistent history.
typesetting: Drawn in TikZ (figure.tex, generated by plot.py; shared colours and type sizes in figstyle.tex) and typeset by XeLaTeX in the acmart typefaces Linux Libertine O and Libertinus Math (fonts/) at the acmart sigconf column width of 241.15 pt, so the paper includes it unscaled and its text matches the body. Text 7-8 pt; sub- and superscripts 6 pt; fonts embedded as CFF subsets.
layout: panel a, titled 'MinIO: same ID, broken continuity': two lanes of version bars with hatched write windows and numbered capture brackets, and a strip that magnifies the time axis 60 times around the fee page's captures; panel b, titled 'Sound outer reads cover the center read': three lanes of capture windows, certain-presence bars, their common band and a schematic read instant
encoding: blue: what a sound field proves (certain presence); red: the inference that fails; grey: states the captures do not show; hatching: write windows in which a state boundary lies
